question.text: After an AIF submits its Action Taken Report (ATR) on SCORES, within how many calendar days can the investor request the First Review by the Designated Body for AIFs?

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Ch 11.7.8, investors in the AIF can request a review of the resolution (First Review) within 15 calendar days of receiving the ATR. If dissatisfied after First Review, they get another 15 days for Second Review escalation to SEBI via SCORES. The Trap: 5 and 10 days truncate the investor's reasonable review window. 30 days overstates it and is not the regulation. Cross-Exam Context: Grievance-escalation windows are heavily tested in III-A (Compliance) and XXIV (AML) for STR/CTR timelines. Manager's Pro-Tip: Send the ATR with a plain-language summary plus the 15-day First Review window disclosure — pre-empting dispute reduces First-Review escalations dramatically in practice.
